claims.value: 1 deposited Thermo RAW acquisitions in the dia-blank subset
claims.evidence: The deposited workbook maps run names and conditions; 120 PRIDE files are classified RAW, and one genuine .raw (20240130_EXPL5_EVO7_FH_SA_HeLa_5ng_sRNG_Pton_fdsm2_03.raw) is misclassified as search output. This subset claims each of its raw files once.

claims.location: source name, comment[technical replicate], factor value[acquisition setting] rows 1-1
claims.evidence: The workbook columns R.FileName, Gradient, Amount, EXP, MS/MS_Resolution and Replicate map each accession run. Its 50-ng DIA fdsm0 replicate-1 row incorrectly repeats _02; it is mapped to the deposited _01 file, leaving a one-to-one map. The paper describes this acquisition design.

claims.location: comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method], comment[dissociation method]
claims.value: Orbitrap Exploris 480; DDA or DIA as indicated; HCD
claims.evidence: The matching paper Methods Mass Spectrometry Analysis names Exploris 480 and the DDA/DIA methods; Table 1 gives HCD energy. PRIDE structured instrument links to an unrelated Astral Zoom study and conflicts with this accession title, file names and matching paper.

claims.location: comment[collision energy], comment[scan window lower limit], comment[scan window upper limit], comment[isolation window width] all rows
claims.evidence: Paper Table 1: HCD energy MS2 27 for all DIA settings. RAW method headers of all 49 DIA runs: "Precursor MassRange (m/z) = 361-1033", "Isolation Window (m/z) = 32", "Number Of Scan Events = 21", "Window Overlap (m/z) = 1". The paper text describes 13.7 m/z x 49 windows, which does not match the deposited runs; the RAW headers are used.
Workbook Amount = 0ng for this run: a zero-load method control.
Spectronaut .sne Enzymes / Cleavage Rules = Trypsin/P, Digest Type Specific; the run list includes all DIA runs and the 0 ng control; the paper describes tryptic HeLa digests.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Acetyl protein N-term and Oxidation M variable
claims.evidence: The control is in the .sne run list and was searched with the same settings: Fixed Carbamidomethyl (C); Variable Acetyl (Protein N-term), Oxidation (M).

limitations: The accession PRIDE structured instrument and linked publication conflict with the deposited run names, experimental workbook and matching paper; the latter identifies Orbitrap Exploris 480.
The workbook contains one repeated _02 name in a DIA condition; its replicate-1 row is reconciled to the deposited _01 run by unique condition and suffix.
The paper Methods state 13.7 m/z windows (49 windows) for DIA, but the deposited RAW method headers show 32 m/z x 21 windows with 1 m/z overlap; the SDRF follows the RAW files.
